lines.en: label utadorm10:
I knock on Uta’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Uta 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: Some pop song with noticeably poor audio quality leaks through the door and into the hall, causing me to immediately second-guess my decision to spend time here.
lines.zh: 某首音质明显很差的流行歌从门缝里漏到走廊上，让我立刻开始怀疑自己待在这儿的决定。

lines.en: : Somebody there? I thought I heard a knock.
lines.zh: : 有人吗？我好像听见敲门声了。

lines.en: : It’s me. Turn your music down.
lines.zh: : 是我。把音乐关小点。

lines.en: : Oh! That’s a great impression of my grandpa, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦！Sensei，你学我爷爷学得真像！

lines.en: : At least before the cancer spread to his brain and he lost the ability to speak.
lines.zh: : 至少在癌症扩散到他脑子、让他失去说话能力之前很像。

lines.en: : Okay, well that’s all the time I have for tonight. See you, Uta.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那今晚我的时间就到此为止了。再见，Uta。

lines.en: : Whaaaat? No! Come inside!
lines.zh: : 什——么？不行！进来！

lines.en: : After listening to you kill the mood like that, it’s going to take some serious convincing to-
lines.zh: : 在听你这么把气氛掐死之后，你得好好说服我一番才——

lines.en: : I’m not wearing any paaaaants~
lines.zh: : 我没穿裤——子哦~

lines.en: scene black
I immediately open the door and second guess why I’d ever debated going home in the first place.
lines.zh: 我立刻推开门，同时开始怀疑自己刚才到底为什么要纠结要不要回家。

lines.en: I mean, Uta is clearly just trying to cope with a horrible tragedy by making light of it and it would be totally wrong of me to abandon her in that state.
lines.zh: 我是说，Uta 显然只是在用开玩笑来消化一场可怕的悲剧，而我要是在这种时候丢下她，就太不应该了。

lines.en: The poor thing is probably in tears as we-
lines.zh: 这可怜的孩子现在大概正哭着呢，就在我们——

lines.en: scene utastretch1
: Coolio! That was just as effective as I thought it was gonna be.
lines.zh: : 酷毙了！这招果然跟我想的一样管用。

lines.en: : What’s up? You bored?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你无聊了？

lines.en: : Wanna stretch with me?
lines.zh: : 要跟我一起拉伸吗？

lines.en: : Only if I can take off {i}my{/i} pants as well.
lines.zh: : 除非我也能把{i}我的{/i}裤子脱了。

lines.en: : Hmm...No thanks. Please leave them on.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢了，不用。请穿着吧。

lines.en: : I understand that I am an adorable, small girl who you’d love to get down and dirty with, but I {i}really{/i} should be focusing on stretching right now.
lines.zh: : 我明白，我是个可爱的小个子女孩，你很想跟我干点坏事，可我现在{i}真的{/i}该专心拉伸。

lines.en: : Why aren’t you wearing any pants anyway?
lines.zh: : 那你到底为什么没穿裤子？

lines.en: : Because I’m {i}stretching{/i}, duh.
lines.zh: : 因为我在{i}拉伸{/i}啊，笨。

lines.en: : Can’t you...do that with pants on?
lines.zh: : 你就不能……穿着裤子拉吗？

lines.en: : I guess, but where’s the fun in that? Why have a dorm if I can’t take my pants off whenever I want?
lines.zh: : 大概能吧，可那有什么意思？既然住了宿舍，还不能想脱裤子就脱裤子吗？

lines.en: : You really are old, aren’t ya?
lines.zh: : 你可真是上了年纪，是吧？

lines.en: I mean...the first thing I said after knocking was to turn the music down...
lines.zh: 我是说……我敲门之后说的第一句话就是让她把音乐关小……

lines.en: Maybe I {i}am{/i} getting old after all?
lines.zh: 也许我{i}真的在{/i}变老了？

lines.en: : Sensei, I was only kidding. There’s no need to look so down all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我刚才是开玩笑的。你不用突然这么沮丧。

lines.en: : Sorry. I just feel like my midlife crisis could kick in at any moment.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是觉得我的中年危机随时可能发作。

lines.en: : Don’t think of that boring ole’ stuff. Just focus on me. But not in a perverted kinda way.
lines.zh: : 别想那些无聊的东西。专心看着我就行。但不是那种色眯眯的专心。

lines.en: : Probably best to put pants on before asking me to make such a dramatic mindset change.
lines.zh: : 在要求我做这么剧烈的心态转变之前，你最好还是把裤子穿上。

lines.en: scene utastretch2
: Nope! Never putting pants on ever again.
lines.zh: : 不要！我这辈子都不穿裤子了。

lines.en: : Oh, how wonderful it is to be young.
lines.zh: : 哦，年轻真好。

lines.en: scene utastretch3
Uta extends her body as far as it will go, letting out a high-pitched, satisfied squeak in the process before taking a step closer to me.
lines.zh: Uta 把身体伸展到极限，过程中发出一声高亢又满足的吱声，然后朝我走近了一步。

lines.en: : Stretching complete. Now I’m finally ready for my real mission.
lines.zh: : 拉伸完毕。现在我终于准备好执行真正的任务了。

lines.en: : What sort of mission doesn’t require pants?
lines.zh: : 什么样的任务是不需要穿裤子的？

lines.en: : Wait. Don’t tell me-
lines.zh: : 等等。你该不会是——

lines.en: : Don’t tell you what? That I’m finally open for business? Not a chance, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你该不会想说我要开门营业了？想得美，Sensei。

lines.en: : Just because I’m pantless and stretchy and telling you I’m ready doesn’t mean I want to get it on.
lines.zh: : 就算我没穿裤子、又软又拉伸完、还告诉你我准备好了，也不代表我就想干那件事。

lines.en: : This is a misunderstanding I really should be forgiven for having.
lines.zh: : 这真是个误会，你应该原谅我产生这种误会。

lines.en: : Forgiveness isn’t necessary at all. If anything, I should be apologizing to you for putting you in such a difficult situation.
lines.zh: : 完全不需要原谅。要说起来，我反倒该向你道歉，把你置于这么为难的境地。

lines.en: scene utastretch4
: But, then again, you’re the one who sprinted in here the second I announced the no-pants thingy, so I guess you kinda {i}are{/i} a little to blame.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，是我一说没穿裤子你就冲进来了，所以我想你多少也{i}有点责任{/i}。

lines.en: The closer Uta gets to me, the harder it is to resist the carnal desire to lift her up and throw her over several piles of clothing and her pet rhinoceros beetle.
lines.zh: Uta 越靠近我，我就越难抵抗那种把她举起来、扔到好几堆衣服和她养的独角仙上去的肉欲。

lines.en: But, as you can see, there are several things about the scenario that make it slightly less erotic.
lines.zh: 可正如你所见，这个场景里有好几样东西让它没那么色情。

lines.en: Besides, it’s kind of fun being the one to actually get teased for once.
lines.zh: 再说了，偶尔当一次被撩的那个其实挺有意思的。

lines.en: I spend so much time tapping into the nervousness of some of the other girls that having someone like Uta around to string me along is sort of...weirdly exciting?
lines.zh: 我花那么多时间去戳其他一些女孩的紧张点，身边有个 Uta 这样的人吊着我，感觉莫名地……兴奋？

lines.en: Completely unsatisfying and dramatically blue balling as well-
lines.zh: 完全得不到满足、还被蓝得要命也是事实——

lines.en: But also exciting.
lines.zh: 可也确实兴奋。

lines.en: Kind of.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene utastretch5
: Hey, question.
lines.zh: : 嘿，问个问题。

lines.en: : I still don’t know a lot of the girls all that well and I know that you do, so like-
lines.zh: : 我对很多女孩还不太熟，而我知道你熟，所以——

lines.en: : I’m not really sure about how...personal I should be with all of 'em.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定跟她们相处该……亲密到什么程度。

lines.en: : My last[school] didn’t have a lot of people in it and the whole dorm-life thing is still new to me, but I don’t wanna be some sorta outcast like Io is going for.
lines.zh: : 我上一所[school]人不多，住宿生活对我来说也还很新鲜，可我不想变成 Io 那种刻意要当的边缘人。

lines.en: : Like, how am I supposed to become friends with everybody?
lines.zh: : 就是说，我该怎么跟所有人成为朋友？

lines.en: : Should I just be myself or should I try and hold back a bit?
lines.zh: : 我应该做自己，还是稍微收敛一点？

lines.en: : I think the location of your pants during this process plays a bigger role than you think it does.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在这个过程中，你裤子的位置比你以为的重要得多。

lines.en: scene utastretch6
: Girls don’t care if other girls don’t wear pants, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 女生不会介意别的女生不穿裤子的，Sensei。

lines.en: : That can not possibly be true.
lines.zh: : 这不可能。

lines.en: : No, no. It really is. We’re not as reserved as you weirdo boys- always too nervous to take off each other's shirts in the locker room and just friggin’...rub each other's bodies from head to toe.
lines.zh: : 不，不。真的。我们可没你们这些怪男生那么拘谨——在更衣室里连脱对方的衣服都不敢，只会他妈的……从头到脚互相蹭身体。

lines.en: : What are you even talking about?
lines.zh: : 你到底在说什么啊？

lines.en: scene utastretch7
: Wouldn’t {i}you{/i} like to know?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}不是很想知道吗？

lines.en: : I just don’t want you to get the wrong impression of me and think that I’m on some mission to remove the clothing of other males.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你误会我，以为我肩负着什么脱掉其他男性衣服的使命。

lines.en: : And rub their bodies from head to toe.
lines.zh: : 然后从头到脚蹭他们的身体。

lines.en: : Yeah, still way off.
lines.zh: : 是啊，还是差得远。

lines.en: scene utastretch8
: Really? Not even a little bit?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？一点都不沾边？

lines.en: : Where’s all the fun in that?
lines.zh: : 那还有什么乐趣可言？

lines.en: : Uta, this might come as a bit of a shock to you, but I-
lines.zh: : Uta，这话也许会让你有点震惊，可我——

lines.en: scene utastretch9
: Ah! Here?! Are you...proposing?!
lines.zh: : 啊！在这儿？！你是……在求婚吗？！

lines.en: : Sensei! It’s so sudden! I don’t know what to say!
lines.zh: : Sensei！太突然了！我不知道该说什么！

lines.en: : In what world would any of this conversation have possibly led up to that?
lines.zh: : 这段对话到底哪一步有可能导向那个结论？

lines.en: : Also, why would you not immediately say no if that were the case?
lines.zh: : 还有，如果真是那样，你为什么不立刻拒绝？

lines.en: : Is it the case?! Do you really love me that much?!
lines.zh: : 是真的吗？！你真的那么爱我？！

lines.en: : My answer to this question is highly dependent on whether or not you’re wearing your maid outfit.
lines.zh: : 我对这个问题的回答，很大程度上取决于你有没有穿女仆装。

lines.en: scene utastretch10
: Damnit, Uta-chan! You were too powerful!
lines.zh: : 可恶，Uta 酱！你太强了！

lines.en: : It only makes sense that this sad, lonely man would fall for you after all of the good times you have shared with him.
lines.zh: : 这个寂寞的可怜男人会在与你共度了那么多美好时光之后爱上你，也是理所当然的。

lines.en: : And now the {i}real{/i} Uta Ushibori must be the one to carry the cross. To accept the lifelong burden of love!
lines.zh: : 而现在，必须由{i}真正{/i}的 Uta Ushibori 来背负这具十字架。来接受爱的终生重担！

lines.en: : Why does it suddenly sound like this is turning into a yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然听起来这要变成“我愿意”了？

lines.en: scene utastretch11
: U-Um...I’m not very good at many things but...if you’ll have me, then...
lines.zh: : 那、那个……我不太擅长很多事情，不过……如果你愿意要我的话，那……

lines.en: : What is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底在发生什么？

lines.en: scene utastretch12
: I do!
lines.zh: : 我愿意！

lines.en: : Not want to marry you!
lines.zh: : 才怪！不想嫁给你！

lines.en: : There it is.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。

lines.en: scene utastretch13
: Heheheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Are you really able to blush on command like that? That was impressive.
lines.zh: : 你真的能说脸红就脸红吗？太厉害了。

lines.en: : Oh, no way. I just actually thought about what it would be like to be married to you and my brain made it seem real {i}way{/i} too quick.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我只是真的想了一下嫁给你会是什么样，而我的脑子{i}太快{/i}就把它当成真的了。

lines.en: : We had a dog and a house and everything.
lines.zh: : 我们还有了狗和房子，什么都有。

lines.en: scene utastretch14
: Oh, and Io lived in a shed in the backyard. Her rent is due on the 1st every month.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有 Io 住在后院的小棚屋里。她的房租每月 1 号到期。

lines.en: if iofirsthall == True:
I guess the tradeskill thing never worked out for her, huh?
lines.zh: 看来她的手艺活一直没能成事啊，是吧？

lines.en: : Weird marriage fantasy aside, I don’t think any of the girls would mind if you just acted like yourself around them.
lines.zh: : 先不提那个奇怪的婚姻幻想，我觉得只要你以真面目示人，那些女孩里没人会介意的。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that’s what we were talking about.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了我们刚才在聊这个了。

lines.en: : You really think that, though? Io says all this stuff about how girls are toxic and like, I guess I’ve kinda seen that in some people at the cafe.
lines.zh: : 不过你真这么认为吗？Io 总说什么女生很毒，而且，我猜我在咖啡厅的一些人身上也确实见识过。

lines.en: : But I like to think everyone is nice overall. At least until something happens to change them.
lines.zh: : 可我愿意相信大家整体上是善良的。至少在有什么事改变他们之前。

lines.en: : You’re an optimist and Io is a pessimist. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 你是乐观主义者，而 Io 是悲观主义者。就这么简单。

lines.en: scene utastretch15
: An optimist? Isn’t that like, an eye doctor?
lines.zh: : 乐观主义者？那不是眼科医生吗？

lines.en: Oh, right.
lines.zh: 哦，对。

lines.en: I suddenly remember what Makoto said about Uta’s grades being pretty horrible.
lines.zh: 我突然想起 Makoto 说过 Uta 的成绩相当糟糕。

lines.en: scene utastretch14
: Oh well. I don’t wanna learn anything when I’m already in comfort-mode.
lines.zh: : 唉，算了。我都进入舒适模式了，才不想学东西呢。

lines.en: : Sensei, wanna go take a trip to the water station thingy with me?
lines.zh: : Sensei，想陪我去一趟那个饮水站什么的吗？

lines.en: : I’m super thirsty and don’t have anything to drink until Io gets back from work tonight.
lines.zh: : 我超渴，而今晚 Io 下班回来之前我这儿什么喝的都没有。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m fine with it but-
lines.zh: : 我是说，我没意见，不过——

lines.en: : Why are you trying so hard to get my pants back on when all you ever do is try to get them off? Choose a side, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你平时拼命想让我把裤子脱掉，现在又这么拼命想让我穿回去。选一边站吧，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
That is...a very good point.
lines.zh: : 这……说得很有道理。

lines.en: The amount of restraint I’ve shown tonight is actually kind of concerning to me.
lines.zh: : 我今晚表现出的自制力，说实话让我自己都有点担心。

lines.en: Hell, all it took was a beetle and some clothes to break my train of thought earlier.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，光是一只甲虫和几件衣服就打断了我的思路。

lines.en: And now I’m casually walking through the halls of a dorm with a girl who still isn’t wearing any pants.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我正和一个依然没穿裤子的女孩悠哉地穿过宿舍走廊。

lines.en: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene utastretch16
: Heheheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~

lines.en: : I feel like the guy from Shawshank Redemption right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉自己像《肖申克的救赎》里的那个人。

lines.en: : Just instead of escaping from jail through the sewers I escaped my dorm room through the sewers of your...mind.
lines.zh: : 只不过他是从下水道逃出监狱，而我是从你……脑子里的下水道逃出了我的宿舍房间。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene utastretch17
: I’m being myself! Just like you told me to!
lines.zh: : 我在做自己啊！就像你教我的那样！

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei! It’s been a real eye-opening experience. I hope the other girls also understand your philosophy.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sensei！这真是让我大开眼界。希望其他女孩也能理解你的哲学。

lines.en: scene utastretch18
: Oh, look! Here come two of them now!
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧！她们中的两个来了！

lines.en: : There is no possible way this can work out in my favor.
lines.zh: : 这事绝对不可能对我有利。

lines.en: scene utastretch19
: Wha-
: Legs.
: Hey, guys!
lines.zh: : 嘿，大家好！

lines.en: : Sensei convinced me that it’s okay to take my pants off. Isn’t that great?
lines.zh: : Sensei 说服了我，让我明白不穿裤子也没关系。很棒吧？

lines.en: scene utastretch20
: He did what?!
lines.zh: : 他干了什么？！

lines.en: : Explain yourself, heathen!
lines.zh: : 给我解释清楚，异教徒！

lines.en: : You dare tread these sacred halls and remove the...sacred kilt off of the...royal maid of...the...
lines.zh: : 你竟敢踏上这些神圣的走廊，还脱下……那件神圣的苏格兰裙，从……王室女仆……的……

lines.en: scene utastretch21
: GAH! I CAN’T EVEN THINK STRAIGHT!
lines.zh: : 啊！我他妈连话都说不利索了！

lines.en: : WHAT HAVE YOU DONE WITH HER PANTS?!
lines.zh: : 你把她的裤子怎么了？！

lines.en: : This is going to sound very hard to believe, but all I did was show up.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来很难让人相信，但我所做的只是出现了而已。

lines.en: : No, no, Sensei! That’s not true at all!
lines.zh: : 不不，Sensei！这完全不是事实！

lines.en: : You taught me {i}so many things{/i} today.
lines.zh: : 你今天教了我{i}好多东西{/i}呢。

lines.en: : SIR! EXPLAIN THE EMPHASIS SHE PLACED ON “SO MANY THINGS.”
lines.zh: : 先生！请解释一下她在“好多东西”上加重语气是什么意思！

lines.en: : I would love to but this is not the first time she has emphasized the most suggestive part of a sentence before.
lines.zh: : 我很想解释，但这已经不是她第一次故意加重句子里最容易引人遐想的那个部分了。

lines.en: : She actually won’t stop and it’s becoming rather difficult to deal with.
lines.zh: : 她根本停不下来，已经变得相当难对付了。

lines.en: : I am also having difficulty dealing with this situation.
lines.zh: : 我也很难应付这个局面。

lines.en: scene utastretch22
: Hey! Maybe you two should stop wearing pants as well? We could form a little club!
lines.zh: : 嘿！也许你们俩也该不穿裤子？我们可以组个小社团！

lines.en: : It would be something us second floor girls could have in common that those {i}losers{/i} downstairs don’t!
lines.zh: : 这会是我们二楼女生才有、楼下那些{i}失败者{/i}没有的共同点！

lines.en: : Sensei even volunteered to sponsor the club and be its formal advisor!
lines.zh: : Sensei 甚至自告奋勇要赞助这个社团，当它的正式顾问呢！

lines.en: : I did no such thing.
lines.zh: : 我可没说过这种话。

lines.en: scene utastretch23
: Sensei! Wanna sponsor our no-pants club?
lines.zh: : Sensei！想赞助我们的不穿裤子社吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 非常愿意。

lines.en: My libido returns. All I needed was more girls.
lines.zh: 我的性欲回来了。我所需要的只是更多女孩。

lines.en: It hasn’t been growing weaker. It has only been increasing in strength.
lines.zh: : 它一直没有变弱。它只是一直在变强。

lines.en: : I-I’M ALREADY IN THE MANGA CLUB! I CAN NOT TURN MY BACK ON MY COMRADES!
lines.zh: : 我、我已经在漫画社了！我不能背弃我的同志们！

lines.en: : I’m in the ramen club.
lines.zh: : 我在拉面社。

lines.en: : Is that actually a club we have at[school]?
lines.zh: : 那真的是我们[school]的社团吗？

lines.en: : I am the only member and the club room is my father’s restaurant.
lines.zh: : 我是唯一的成员，而社团活动室就是我爸的餐厅。

lines.en: : That’s not a club. That’s just your job.
lines.zh: : 那不叫社团。那只是你的工作。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 操你的。

lines.en: scene utastretch24
: Heheh~ Having floormates is fun!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~有同楼的伙伴真好玩！

lines.en: : I guess it {i}is{/i} fine to be myself after all.
lines.zh: : 看来{i}确实{/i}做自己也没关系。

lines.en: : We don’t need pants to have good time! All we need is-
lines.zh: : 我们不需要裤子也能玩得开心！我们只需要——

lines.en: : PANTS! OR A SKIRT OR...SOMETHING!
lines.zh: : 裤子！或者裙子，或者……随便什么！

lines.en: : THERE COULD BE...GIRLS WHO ARE ALSO INTO GIRLS AND...HAVE A HARD TIME...NOT STARING!
lines.zh: : 说不定会有……同样喜欢女生的女生，而且……很难……忍住不看！

lines.en: scene utastretch25
: Ahh, yes. The Lebanese.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。黎巴嫩人。

lines.en: : Lesbians, Tsuneyo. Lebanese are people from Lebanon.
lines.zh: : 是女同性恋啦，Tsuneyo。黎巴嫩人是来自黎巴嫩的人。

lines.en: : An entire country where it is fine to love whoever you want. What a magical place.
lines.zh: : 整个国家都能随心所欲地爱任何人。真是个神奇的地方。

lines.en: : You can stare if you want, Molly! Sensei’s been staring all night and I don’t care at all.
lines.zh: : 你想看就看吧，Molly！Sensei 整晚都在看，我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : I never said I was talking about myself! The...Kendo Princess here...loves girls! It’s true!
lines.zh: : 我可没说我在说我自己！这位……剑道公主……喜欢女生！是真的！

lines.en: : I don’t think I am Lebanese but my mother comes from Egypt. Is that nearby?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我是黎巴嫩人，不过我妈妈来自埃及。那算近吗？

lines.en: : Kind of? I’m not that familiar with geography from that part of the world.
lines.zh: : 算吧？我对那个地区的地理不太熟。

lines.en: : Then perhaps I am Lebanese after all.
lines.zh: : 那也许我果然是黎巴嫩人。

lines.en: scene black
I decide that it might be best for everyone if I just slowly back away while all of their eyes are closed.
lines.zh: 我认定，趁她们都闭着眼睛的时候悄悄后退，对大家都好。

lines.en: Part of me wanted to stick around and wait to see if anymore pants/skirts came off but, judging by Molly’s reaction and Tsuneyo’s...inaction, I can’t see that happening.
lines.zh: 我有一部分想留下来，看看还有没有裤子／裙子会被脱掉，不过从 Molly 的反应和 Tsuneyo 的……无动于衷来看，我认为那不会发生。

lines.en: Either way, it was nice seeing Uta finding the courage to strike up a conversation with some of the other girls on her floor.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，看到 Uta 终于鼓起勇气跟同楼的其他女孩搭话，挺好的。

lines.en: It was also nice seeing her without her pants on.
lines.zh: 看到她没穿裤子的样子，也挺好的。

lines.en: I hope to do more of that in the future.
lines.zh: : 我希望以后能多看几次。
